## TL;DR

In the last two weeks, **CCH Studio graduated from a Houzz replacement into an opinionated, AI-augmented studio operating system.** Major data integrity work landed (Maverick, Cloud HB/Parker/Mustang, image rescue), the PO → Bill → QB workflow shipped to production solving a 5+ year Houzz pain point, and three architectural specs for AI agent layers (Chief of Staff, CFO, CMO) are in place for Cursor to build.

## ✅ Shipped — Features in production

| Feature | Date | Where it landed |
|---|---|---|
| **PO → Bill → QB workflow (bill-only path)** | May 28 | Studio PO + vendor bill + `pushBillToQB` Cloud Function. PO stays locked after Send. Solves the Houzz retro-edit pain. |
| **Firestore rules Phase 1** | May 28 | `/products` create/update now require `isAuth()` on both staging + production. |
| **Houzz/Ivy CDN migration** | May 19–24 | Ivy S3 URLs migrated; 20,375 images saved to Firebase Storage as `houzz-products/<houzzId>/<slot>.<ext>` (9.97 GB). Multiple backups (Firebase, Toshiba, CCH Dropbox). |
| **Invoice edit/view split** | May 22 | Edit = line items only · View = totals / payments / QB / client sidebar. No Unit column. Shipping = freight fee. Verified on IN-12946. |
| **Houzz Design-Service Tax Audit** | May 19 | `cchInvoiceLineIsTaxable()` + `expenseType` set on service lines so design services aren't taxed as products. |
| **Sync QB Paid UI** | May 20 | "↻ Sync QB paid" button on All Invoices + per-invoice row menu. |
| **qbWebhook Gen2 migration** | May 20 | Cloud Functions for QB payment events (BillPayment → PO, Payment Create/Update, Intuit webhook challenge). |
| **Invoice number backfill (firm-wide)** | May 22 + 27 | All invoices now have `number` field set (was undefined; only `invoiceNum` was populated). |
| **Cloud HB / Parker / Mustang invoice dedup** | May 27 | 179 duplicate invoice docs merged (HB 26 + Parker 110 + Mustang 43). Client portal can now share without dupes. |
| **Cloud Rolling Hills client portal** | May 13 → ongoing | Inspiration board restoration + Whitesail backfill + Katke phantom cleanup. 7 portal hardening patches deployed. |
| **Line image upload (proposals + invoices)** | May 19 | `docLineImageStoragePath()` canonical; Storage rules updated for octet-stream content type. |
